name: Mini Mechs
summary:
Move your mech around a battlefield and battle other mechs, tanks, spiders and turrets, each with unique armory and behaviour.

You play from a third-person perspective, while your mech's arms mimic the movements of your controllers.

Select a camera view that best suits your comfort level:
- aligned on mech's forward direction
- aligned relative to mech's xy-position
- aligned relative to mech's x-position
